name: Wildheart
description:
Voices of the Living World

Wildhearts draw their magic from the living world itself: soil and root, tooth and wing, growth and rot. They are not masters of nature, but participants in it, adapting as the environment changes and allowing its rhythms to shape their own abilities.

Each Wildheart walks alongside an animal guide whose instincts and form influence their path. Their magic entangles, regenerates, poisons, and transforms, favoring persistence over spectacle.

Nature does not rush.
Neither do Wildhearts.

Domains of Magic

Wildhearts wield magic born of ecosystems and instinct:

  • Plants and animals as allies and weapons

  • Growth, decay, poison, and disease

  • Environmental control and area denial

  • Shapeshifting and adaptation

  • Endurance and regeneration through symbiosis

Taboo: Extraction

Wildhearts reject magic that takes without giving back.

Nothing lives alone.

Fault Lines

  • Arcanists reduce life to equations.

  • Votaries claim authority over what Wildhearts consider inviolate.
